title: Suno arsh walo Sehra ali ka
body:
Suno arsh walo Sehra ali ka
Mubarak-3
Ali Ali
Marhaba-6
Madina e nabawi ko sajaya jata Hai, zameen e sehra ko jannat banaya jata hai, KHUDA ki sari KHUDAYI khadi hai sunne ko, ABU TURAB ka sehra sunaya jata hai.
Mubarak-5
Mubarak mubarak tumhe ya NABI
ALI aur ZEHRA ki shadi hui, {Suno arsh walo'n Suno farsh walo'n
mai sehra ALI ka sunane chala hun} -4
Jo sun kar ye sehra hai jalte hamesha-2
Unhe aur bhi mai sunane jalane chala hun.
1) Padhu'n tere DADA ki shadi ka manzar, Ay mere IMAM E ZAMANA  madad kar
Maula madad kar
Tasavvur me har ek momin ko-2
ALI ka barati banane chala hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
2) KHUDA kehta hoga agar hota KABAH, Mere Ghar se hi jati (baraat iski)-2
Ye mera WALI hai so iske liye mai
madine ko KABAH banane chala hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
3) KHUDA k WALI ki hai shadi ka mauqa, Siwaye charagho'n k kuch na jalega, Kaha ye farishte ne hukm e KHUDA SE
mai naar e jahannum bujhane chala hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Ata karke HAIDER ko ZEHRA si zauja, Pukara falak par ye (MABOOD mera)-2
ALI ne banayi hai qismat jahan ki
ALI ki mai qismat banane chala hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) KHUDA keh raha tha MOHAMMED falak par, Kai baar aaye the ZEHRA ki khatir, So mera'j ka ab naya mai thikana
dar E MURTUZA ko banane chala hun.
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Ghadi rukhsati ki Takkalum jab aayi, Hijab E ILAHI se awaaz aayi-2
ALI meri Surat hai ZEHRA hai aayat-2
Mai Aayat se Surat milane chala hun.
Suno arsh walo'n Suno farsh walo'n
mai sehra ALI ka sunane chala hun.
author: Mir Hassan Mir
